reason: The latest macro validation HR@10 of 0.4975 trails the 0.505 baseline, with regressions in Electronics and Industrial_and_Scientific despite improvement in CDs_and_Vinyl; these results motivate testing broader history access without establishing its absence as the cause. Historical examples support combining causal sequence modeling with attention pooling, while failed embedding-separation and objective changes favor retaining the current shared embeddings and loss. Modify model_design for the jointly trained gated representation and training_evaluation for matching checkpoint reconstruction and controlled validation.

plan.model_design: Extend the existing SASRec with a learned history-attention query and an elementwise gate, retaining its causal Transformer blocks, shared item_emb, final_norm, normalized scoring, learned scale, and jointly trained item_bias. For every position t, compute query–embedding attention logits scaled by sqrt(hidden), mask padding and positions after t, and pool the shared item embeddings from the visible prefix; explicitly produce zero pooled vectors for empty prefixes to avoid nonfinite softmax outputs. Project the pooled vector to hidden dimensions and compute g = sigmoid(gate(concat(x, pooled))), then replace x immediately before final_norm with g * x + (1 - g) * pooled and zero padding positions. Initialize the gate weights to zero and its bias to 2 so training initially favors the existing sequential representation, allowing broader interests to contribute through gradients from the unchanged ranking_loss. Preserve SASRec.__init__, log2feats, predict, ranking_loss, existing attribute names, and tensor shapes, adding only internal parameters so all training positions and inference use the same causal gated features within one network.
plan.training_evaluation: Preserve SequenceDataset prefix sampling, NEGATIVES=256, negative exclusion, transition selection and weighting, sampled-softmax loss, AdamW settings, learning-rate schedule, gradient clipping, architecture dimensions, and existing hyperparameters to isolate the representation change. Keep the supplied splits and preprocessing seed 0 unchanged, seed_all(42) per category, fixed validation_arrays with evaluation seed 42, EPOCHS default 200 with its environment override, and existing validation frequency, stopping rules, and time limits. Preserve train_category(name, device), evaluate(model, arrays, device), write_predict_script(), and the predictor signature; ensure the writer reconstructs the modified SASRec from checkpoint config and strictly loads its complete state_dict, selecting exactly one newly trained checkpoint per category without averaging or auxiliary fitted scorers. Add lightweight checks for finite pooled features and gradients, invariance of earlier valid features to changed future items, and checkpoint-reload prediction parity, without additional training runs. Retain DATA_DIR=os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR'], all four DATASETS and routes, trial-local WORKING artifacts, and single-GPU execution; report actual per-category and macro validation HR@10 against 0.4975 and 0.505, leaving the pinned host evaluator and hidden test data untouched.
